derivation:
by
  simp only [MeasureTheory.volume_pi_closedBall a hr, volume_closedBall, Finset.prod_const]
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_pow (mul_nonneg zero_le_two hr) _).symm
explanation: The general product-space theorem gives the volume as the product of the coordinate closed-ball volumes. Specializing each coordinate to ℝ and simplifying with the real closed-ball formula yields the stated power formula; the current proof already uses this theorem.
